title: Schema for the missions data file: an index of every mission, whichever collection its card is in

id.description: Id for entry: a UUID (see docs/data-model.md).

content_type.description: The collection the mission is in (agenda-cards: an agenda card that is a mission).

content_id.description: The mission's id in that collection.

map_id.description: Foreign key to the map in data/maps.json the mission is played on; null only when the dataset has no image of it (campaign maps, for now).

location.description: Where the mission's rules are, for a campaign or agenda mission: a book and page ("Campaign Guide, page 4", "Twin Shadows Rulebook, page 8"), or a pack's rules sheet ("Han Solo Rules Sheet"), from zackgomez.com's Campaign Tile Guide. null for skirmish and raid missions.
